# Daniel J. Faiella Insurance Advisors

> Independent Medicare, life, long-term care, health and annuity insurance broker based in Carson City, Nevada, serving all of Northern Nevada: Reno, Sparks, Minden, Gardnerville, Genoa, Dayton, Fernley, Fallon, and the Nevada side of Lake Tahoe (Incline Village to Stateline). Daniel teaches first, then compares A+ rated carriers side by side. Consultations and plan comparisons are free — the broker is paid by the carrier the client chooses, and premiums are the same either way.

Contact: call or text 775-315-5572 · faiella.daniel@gmail.com · Carson City, NV · [Contact page](https://faiellainsurance.com/contact)
Hours: open 24 hours a day, by appointment.
Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=7820892945307879894
Not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. government or the federal Medicare program. Medicare disclosure: we do not offer every plan available in your area; contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE for information on all options.

## Key facts

- Working with Daniel costs clients $0 — he is paid by the carrier the client chooses, and the premium is identical either way.
- Fully independent broker (not captive): compares A+ rated carriers side by side rather than selling one company's menu.
- Meets clients in person anywhere in Northern Nevada — kitchen table, coffee shop, or video call.
- Nevada-licensed insurance producer; teaches the fundamentals first so clients understand coverage before they buy.
- Military retirees near NAS Fallon: honest TRICARE For Life + Medicare coordination guidance (often the answer is "you don't need to buy anything").

- [All services](https://faiellainsurance.com/services): Overview of everything Daniel helps with.

- [Life Insurance — Term, Whole Life, IUL & Final Expense](https://faiellainsurance.com/services/life-insurance): Honest comparison of term, whole life, indexed universal life, final expense and living benefits.
- [Annuities & Retirement Income Planning](https://faiellainsurance.com/services/annuities): Fixed and indexed annuities, immediate income (SPIA), guaranteed lifetime withdrawal benefits, RMD planning.
- [Long-Term Care Insurance](https://faiellainsurance.com/services/long-term-care): Traditional LTC, hybrid life + LTC, short-term care; Medicare does not cover ongoing custodial care.
- [Health Insurance & Income Protection](https://faiellainsurance.com/services/health-insurance): Under-65 health coverage, hospital indemnity, disability income, dental/vision/hearing, critical illness.

- [How an Annuity With Guaranteed Lifetime Withdrawals Can Pay Your IRA's RMDs](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/annuities-guaranteed-lifetime-withdrawals-rmds): IRA aggregation rule, SECURE 2.0, sequence-of-returns protection.

- [Beneficiary Designations: The Nevada Retirement Mistake That Overrides Your Will](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/beneficiary-designations-retirement-estate-planning-nevada): Your IRA, 401(k), annuity and life insurance don't pass through your will — they pass to whoever is named on the beneficiary form. Here's how Nevada retirees get this wrong, and how to fix it.
- [Estate Planning for Blended Families in Nevada: How Life Insurance Keeps Everyone Whole](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/blended-family-estate-planning-nevada): In a second marriage, "everything to my spouse" can quietly disinherit your children. How Nevada community property affects blended families, and how life insurance and trusts provide for your spouse and your kids.

How critical illness and accident insurance pay you directly to cover the deductibles, travel and lost income your Nevada health plan leaves behind.
- [Fixed Annuities vs. CDs in Nevada: Where to Keep Your Safe Money](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/fixed-annuities-vs-cds-nevada): Both protect your principal — but a bank CD and a fixed (MYGA) annuity are taxed, guaranteed, and accessed in very different ways. A plain-English comparison for Nevada savers deciding where to park safe money.
- [Fixed vs. Fixed Indexed Annuities in Nevada: Growth Without the Market Risk](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/fixed-vs-indexed-annuities-nevada): Fixed vs. fixed indexed annuities for Nevada retirees, explained in plain English: how each earns interest, caps and floors, what the guarantees really mean, and how to tell which fits.

A plain-English walkthrough of how to calculate the life insurance coverage a Nevada family actually needs — using the DIME method, what to subtract, and where people get it wrong.
- [HSAs & High-Deductible Health Plans in Nevada: The Triple Tax Advantage (2026)](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/hsa-high-deductible-health-plans-nevada): How high-deductible health plans and HSAs work together in Nevada: the 2026 limits, the triple tax advantage, why the state's lack of an income tax makes an HSA even cleaner, and who a high-deductible plan actually fits.
- [What Happens to Your Paycheck If You Can't Work?](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/income-protection-insurance-nevada): Nevada has no state disability insurance program. Here's what actually replaces your income if illness or injury keeps you out of work, what it costs, and who needs it most.
- [Do You Still Need Life Insurance in Retirement? A Nevada Guide](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/life-insurance-in-retirement-nevada): Whether to keep, drop, or convert your life insurance once you retire in Nevada — the real reasons retirees still carry coverage, when it's safe to let a policy go, and how to decide.
- [Life Insurance Living Benefits in Nevada: The Riders That Pay You While You're Still Here](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/life-insurance-living-benefits-nevada): Modern life insurance can pay you while you're still living — if a terminal, chronic, or critical illness strikes. How accelerated death benefit riders work in Nevada, what they cost, and how the payout and taxes play out.
- [Do You Need a Living Trust in Nevada? Avoiding Probate and Protecting Your Estate](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/living-trusts-avoiding-probate-nevada): A will still goes through Nevada probate — a living trust doesn't. How probate actually works in Nevada, what a revocable living trust changes, and why Nevada is one of the best states in the country to hold one.
- [No-Exam Life Insurance in Nevada: Faster Coverage, and When It's Worth It](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/no-exam-life-insurance-nevada): Dreading the medical exam — or worried a health condition will disqualify you? A plain-English guide to no-exam, simplified-issue, and guaranteed-issue life insurance in Nevada: how each type of underwriting works, what it costs, and which one actually fits.
- [Under-65 Health Insurance in Nevada: Nevada Health Link vs. Short-Term Plans](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/under-65-health-insurance-nevada): Self-employed or between jobs in Nevada? A clear comparison of Nevada Health Link, short-term plans, COBRA and association plans — costs, subsidies and where people get burned.
- [Term Life Conversion in Nevada: Keep Your Coverage When the Term Runs Out](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/term-life-conversion-nevada): Most term life policies include a conversion option that lets you switch to permanent coverage with no new medical exam. How term conversion works, the deadline most Nevadans miss, and when it's worth using.
- [Group vs. Individual Life Insurance in Nevada: Is Your Work Coverage Enough?](https://faiellainsurance.com/blog/group-vs-individual-life-insurance-nevada): The life insurance through your job is cheap and easy, but it's tied to that job, usually too small, and gone when you leave. How group and individual coverage compare, the portability and conversion traps when you change jobs, and why most Nevada families need a policy they own.
